Made by combining these items in the [[Mystic Forge]]: * 1 [[Bloodstone Shard]] * 250 [[Obsidian Shards]] * 1 [[Gift of Exploration]] * 1 [[Gift of Battle]] | rarity = Legendary | value = 640 | bound = Account | collection = Legendary Weapon: Bolt; Legendary Weapon: Frenzy; Legendary Weapon: Frostfang; Legendary Weapon: Howler; Legendary Weapon: Incinerator; Legendary Weapon: Kamohoali'i Kotaki; Legendary Weapon: Kraitkin; Legendary Weapon: Kudzu; Legendary Weapon: Meteorlogicus; Legendary Weapon: Quip; Legendary Weapon: Rodgort; Legendary Weapon: Sunrise; Legendary Weapon: The Bifrost; Legendary Weapon: The Dreamer; Legendary Weapon: The Flameseeker Prophecies; Legendary Weapon: The Juggernaut; Legendary Weapon: The Minstrel; Legendary Weapon: The Moot; Legendary Weapon: The Predator; Legendary Weapon: Twilight | id = 19674 }} [[Gift of Mastery]] is a [[trophy]] used to make Generation 1 [[legendary weapons]]. == Acquisition == {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Bloodstone Shard | ingredient2 = 250 Obsidian Shard | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Exploration | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Battle }} === Contained in === {{Contained in}} === Other === * Placing second in the [[Automated Tournaments#Tournament of Legends|Tournament of Legends]]. == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Notes == * In total it requires: ** {{spirit shard|200}} [[Spirit Shard]]s ** 100% [[Map completion|World Completion]] ** Completion of the [[Gift of Battle Item Reward Track]] ** [[Character#Progression|Level]] 80 ** {{Karma|525000}} [[Karma]] or 3,750 {{token|Fractals of the Mists}} [[Fractal Relic|Fractal Relics]] or 252 {{Laurel}} [[Laurel|Laurels]] or ({{Karma|262500}} [[Karma]] and 6,250 of any HoT currency).
